sanitize_js_file.name: sanitize_js_file

params.input: Create a Node.js function that accepts a file path to a JavaScript file, reads its contents, removes trailing spaces on each line, adds semicolons at the end of statements that are missing them (simple heuristic: lines ending with an assignment, function definition, or expression that do not already have a semicolon, closing brace, opening brace, or line starting with an if/for/while/import/export), collapses string literals longer than 80 characters into concatenated strings with plus signs (simple heuristic: split at 80 chars inside the string), and writes the cleaned content to a new file in the same directory with the same filename appended with `-atlas.js` (e.g., `cli.js` -> `cli-atlas.js`). The function should return the path of the created file.

sanitize_file_path.name: sanitize_file_path
